  - _Done:_ Planned to make the column-mapping misconfiguration class impossible after the user's saved mapping pointed the workdays numbers field at the end-date column, so the numeric write clobbered the date and every create_item failed with ColumnValueException.   - _Done:_ Planned to stop the settings-dialog flicker loop the user reported right after the 2026-06-10 deploy.
